title: Signal: Conan source download cache left empty
scope: A global.conf file that declares an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time.
limitations: It matches an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time in the parsed global.conf; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A global.conf that mentions an empty `download_cache` that re-fetches sources every time in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
